ssml: <speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Welcome.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Here is how today's exercise works, and what we ask of you.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">First, the most important thing.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">This exercise tests the plan,<break time="250ms"/> not individuals.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Findings are reported at team level, and the report names no one.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Each inject — a message, a phone call, an alert — appears on the room screen and on your phone,</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">with a countdown at the top that turns amber in the last minute.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Most injects need one answer per department: agree it together; one person types.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">If that phone is busy or gone, press <break time="350ms"/>"Take over" — the text so far comes with you.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Some injects ask everyone to answer alone; the screen says so.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Press <break time="350ms"/>"Submit answer" before the time ends.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Until then, <break time="350ms"/>"Edit answer" lets you change it — then press <break time="350ms"/>"Submit changes".</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Need more time?</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">In Messages, send <break time="350ms"/>"We need a few more minutes".</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Extra time, when given, is for everyone.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Facilitator messages appear at the top: Reply, or Got it.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Keep the exercise page open, your phone on Do Not Disturb — not flight mode — and plugged in if you can.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">If the page closes, open the join link again.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">At the end, a one-minute survey.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Please answer it before you leave.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">That's all.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Your facilitator will start the exercise shortly.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Welcome, and thank you for observing.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">In two minutes: what you do, and how your phone helps.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">You watch and take notes.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">You don't answer injects, and you don't guide the team — even when they are stuck.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">What you see becomes the evidence in the report.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Your phone has three tabs.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Exercise shows what the room sees — plus what to watch for on this inject, and which departments have answered.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Never what they wrote.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">To log a note: tap the type — Positive, Needs improvement, or Critical gap.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Check the department; it is filled in when the inject names one.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Write a few sentences and press <break time="350ms"/>"Log note".</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">A topic is optional — we classify afterwards.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Prefer to speak?</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Tap the microphone, say your note, tap it again to stop, and correct the words in the box.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Speaking never sends anything — <break time="350ms"/>"Log note" does.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">PlanProof keeps only the text, never the recording.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Write what the team did, and what the plan says — for example:</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">"The team called the supplier before checking the contract; the plan says to check it first."</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Never name a person.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">A <break time="350ms"/>"Critical gap" note alerts the facilitator at once.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Use it when the plan itself fails or is missing something critical — not for a slow decision.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Messages reaches the facilitator: tap a ready-made line —</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%"><break time="350ms"/>"Our room needs more time", <break time="350ms"/>"A question from our room" — and Send.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Replies arrive at the top of your screen.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">After the exercise ends, your notes and messages stay open for up to five hours — finish your notes while it's fresh.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Then a one-minute survey.</prosody></voice></speak>

<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">That's the only video on your phone today.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Now set your phone to silent.</prosody></voice></speak>
<speak version="1.0" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2001/10/synthesis" xml:lang="en-GB"><voice name="en-GB-RyanNeural"><prosody rate="-5%">Thank you.</prosody></voice></speak>
